selected_direction: Each workspace tab owns a split tree; every leaf owns conversation tabs. One session has one durable state, independent of pane geometry and window location.
behaviors: Nested splits in main and auxiliary windows
Drag conversation tabs to merge or split; drag group grip to move a group
Explicit tab menu for equivalent keyboard operations
Real browser auxiliary window, return one tab or all; close restores conversations
Active input target indicated on pane chrome
Draft, reply, attachments, queue, approval, tool expansion, caret and scroll survive layout moves

responsive.basis: Actual iframe/pane CSS pixel dimensions, not outer browser width
responsive.desktop_enter: Always send independent of pane width; Shift+Enter inserts newline; IME is guarded
responsive.narrow: Collapse local header controls and show review inside the pane
responsive.short: Compact composer and controls without dropping drafts or queue
responsive.too_small: Show focused pane with a pane switcher; retain split tree for later restoration

prototype_boundary: Existing standalone chat is embedded in stable per-session frames for in-window moves. Auxiliary transfers serialize fixture UI state. Real Electron implementation must keep the existing Dockview panel instance and provider/PTY lifecycle; web prototype is not native-session validation.
